definitions: Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.
Having or showing a high opinion of one's own dignity, importance, or superiority.
Having a specified quality to an extent that excites admiration or praise.
(Of an object) projecting from a surface.
examples: She was proud of her son's achievements.
He was too proud to ask for help.
The nail was proud of the surface.
